{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify and remove QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel to assess confounding
crosstab = pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment'])
print('Customer segment distribution by channel:')
print(crosstab)

# Compute average revenue per order by channel
grouped_revenue = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean().round(2)
print('\nAverage revenue per completed order by channel:')
print(grouped_revenue)

# Compute average revenue per order by channel and customer_segment to adjust for confounding
adjusted_revenue = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().round(2)
print('\nAverage revenue per completed order by channel and customer_segment:')
print(adjusted_revenue)"}
